study type: Nested case control study within a cohort
cohort: 99 women with pregnancy-related hypertension who delivered at a single institution between 2005 and 2009
finding: Postpartum readmission for hypertension in women with known pregnancy-related hypertension was not associated with mode of delivery but was associated with longer length of labor and less likely in those initially started on antihypertensive medications.
mod_finding: Postpartum readmission for hypertension in women with known pregnancy-related hypertension was not associated with mode of delivery.
